sql.sql:
SELECT internal_app_runs.instance_id, internal_instances.source_app_id AS app_id, internal_releases.project_id, internal_instances.project_id AS instance_project_id, runs.project_id AS run_project_id 
FROM internal_run_bindings JOIN internal_app_runs ON internal_run_bindings.app_run_id = internal_app_runs.id JOIN internal_releases ON internal_app_runs.release_id = internal_releases.id JOIN internal_instances ON internal_app_runs.instance_id = internal_instances.id JOIN runs ON internal_run_bindings.run_id = runs.id 
WHERE internal_run_bindings.run_id = ? AND internal_app_runs.principal_id = ? AND internal_instances.principal_id = ? AND internal_releases.principal_id = ? AND runs.principal_id = ?
